answer_1.quote: The derived rules were used to generate high-quality training data using LLMs and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of the generated data, we produced 200 PHL triples for each rule and randomly sampled 40 triples per rule for manual assessment, measuring accuracy based on whether the premise-hypothesis relationships adhered to their intended rule patterns.

answer_3.quote: For each cluster, we provide the set of premise-hypothesis-label-explanation (PHL+E) quadruples and instruct the LLM to evaluate whether the examples correspond to any of the 15 existing rules.
